rics.meaning: Actual NOPA monthly soybean oil inventory stocks in millions of pounds, measuring crude soy oil held by processing members.
rics.how_to_use: Tight stocks indicate strong biofuel or food demand; bearish if above consensus (ample supply). Compare with CBOT soybean oil futures (BO) for basis moves.

rics.meaning: Median consensus forecast for NOPA soybean oil stocks from the Reuters pre-release poll, typically from ~10 analysts.
rics.how_to_use: Primary benchmark for CBOT soy oil surprise; print below median (tighter stocks) is bullish for BO futures and soybean complex broadly.

rics.meaning: Mean forecast for NOPA bean oil stocks across all Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Compare vs median; mean-median divergence in small-sample agri polls is common — weight median more heavily for market impact assessment.

rics.meaning: Mode forecast for NOPA bean oil stocks among Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: With a small analyst panel, mode can equal median; large gap signals diverse views on seasonal drawdown pace or biofuel demand.

rics.meaning: Minimum individual forecast for NOPA bean oil stocks in the Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Defines most bullish (tightest supply) scenario; actual below min is a major upside surprise for CBOT BO futures and soy crush margins.

rics.meaning: Maximum individual forecast for NOPA bean oil stocks in the Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Defines most bearish (loosest supply) scenario; actual above max pressures BO futures and signals weaker biofuel or export demand than expected.

rics.description: Bean Oil Stocks — Forecast Standard Deviation
rics.meaning: Standard deviation of NOPA bean oil stocks forecasts across Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Small analyst panel means StdDev can be large relative to median; high uncertainty reflects variable biofuel blending mandate pace.

rics.meaning: SmartEconomics model-based forecast for NOPA bean oil stocks.
rics.how_to_use: Compare vs median; model may incorporate crush pace, biofuel mandate data, and export inspections to produce a supply-side estimate.

rics.meaning: Predicted surprise for NOPA bean oil stocks — directional estimate of deviation from consensus at release.
rics.how_to_use: Use pre-release to set bias for CBOT soy oil and RD/RIN (renewable diesel) feedstock trades; tighter-than-expected stocks lift biofuel margins.

rics.description: Bean Oil Stocks — Number of Forecasters
rics.meaning: Number of analysts submitting a bean oil stocks forecast in the current Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: NOPA polls draw a small specialist panel (~8-15 respondents); interpret consensus with caution when count is below 10.

rics.meaning: Actual USDA quarterly US soybean stocks (on-farm + off-farm), released four times per year in the Grain Stocks report.
rics.how_to_use: Major price-moving report for CBOT soybeans (ZS); stocks below consensus trigger limit-up moves. December 1 stocks are especially critical for new-crop supply outlook.

rics.meaning: Median consensus forecast for USDA quarterly soybean stocks from the Reuters pre-release poll.
rics.how_to_use: Primary benchmark for CBOT ZS surprise; actual below median is strongly bullish for soybeans — these quarterly reports drive multi-cent daily moves in futures.

rics.meaning: Mean forecast for USDA quarterly soybean stocks across all Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Compare with median to assess distribution skew; large crop years may generate outlier high-stocks forecasts pulling mean above median.

rics.meaning: Mode forecast for USDA quarterly soybean stocks among Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Mode near median confirms tight analyst consensus; mode far from median indicates split views on on-farm vs commercial storage allocation.

rics.meaning: Minimum individual forecast for USDA quarterly soybean stocks in the Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Defines the most bullish (tightest supply) analyst scenario; actual below min triggers strongest soybean futures buying as all scenarios are exceeded.

rics.meaning: Maximum individual forecast for USDA quarterly soybean stocks in the Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Defines the most bearish (most abundant supply) scenario; actual above max triggers downside ZS price pressure as supply exceeds all analyst estimates.

rics.description: Qtrly Grain Stocks-Soy — Forecast Standard Deviation
rics.meaning: Standard deviation of USDA quarterly soybean stocks forecasts across Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: High StdDev ahead of the June stocks (new-crop transition) reflects maximum uncertainty in on-farm usage estimates; low StdDev in late-season indicates predictable drawdown.

rics.meaning: SmartEconomics model-based forecast for USDA quarterly soybean stocks.
rics.how_to_use: Compare vs median; model incorporates crush pace, export inspections, and USDA supply/use balance adjustments to estimate residual stocks.

rics.meaning: Predicted surprise for USDA quarterly soybean stocks — directional estimate of actual vs consensus deviation.
rics.how_to_use: High-value pre-release signal for CBOT soy positioning; a strongly negative predicted surprise (tighter stocks) ahead of Dec 1 or Mar 1 stocks supports aggressive long ZS trades.

rics.description: Qtrly Grain Stocks-Soy — Number of Forecasters
rics.meaning: Number of analysts submitting a quarterly soybean stocks forecast in the current Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Grain stocks polls attract a specialist agri panel; validate consensus reliability — low count near major USDA reports increases surprise risk.

rics.meaning: Actual USDA quarterly US wheat stocks (all positions: on-farm + off-farm) released in the Grain Stocks report four times per year.
rics.how_to_use: Price-moving report for CBOT wheat futures (ZW); tighter-than-expected stocks drive export premium and affect global flour/bread price chain.

rics.meaning: Median consensus forecast for USDA quarterly wheat stocks from the Reuters pre-release poll.
rics.how_to_use: Primary benchmark for CBOT ZW surprise; lower-than-expected stocks relative to median is bullish for wheat, especially when global supply is already tight.

rics.meaning: Mean forecast for USDA quarterly wheat stocks across all Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Compare mean vs median to assess distribution shape; large winter wheat crop estimates can produce outlier high-stock forecasts that pull mean above median.

rics.meaning: Mode forecast for USDA quarterly wheat stocks among Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Mode clustering near median confirms tight consensus on wheat supply-use balance; divergence signals uncertainty in feed-wheat usage or export pace.

rics.meaning: Minimum individual forecast for USDA quarterly wheat stocks in the Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Defines the most bullish (tightest supply) analyst scenario for wheat; actual below min is a limit-up ZW signal in tight global markets.

rics.meaning: Maximum individual forecast for USDA quarterly wheat stocks in the Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Defines the most bearish (most abundant supply) wheat scenario; actual above max is a negative price signal for ZW, especially in large domestic harvest years.

rics.description: Qtrly Grain Stocks-Wheat — Forecast Standard Deviation
rics.meaning: Standard deviation of USDA quarterly wheat stocks forecasts across Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Elevated StdDev in the June stocks report reflects maximum uncertainty about winter-wheat harvest size; cross-check with USDA crop condition ratings.

rics.meaning: SmartEconomics model-based forecast for USDA quarterly wheat stocks.
rics.how_to_use: Compare vs median; model integrates USDA weekly export inspections, flour mill usage, and feed residual estimates to project stocks.

rics.meaning: Predicted surprise for USDA quarterly wheat stocks — directional estimate of actual vs consensus deviation.
rics.how_to_use: High-value pre-release signal for ZW futures; in low global stock environments (e.g., post-Ukraine supply shock), negative predicted surprise has outsized price impact.

rics.description: Qtrly Grain Stocks-Wheat — Number of Forecasters
rics.meaning: Number of analysts submitting a quarterly wheat stocks forecast in the current Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Agri specialist panel similar in size to soy stocks poll; low count increases noise in consensus estimates — validate with USDA export inspection data.

rics.meaning: Actual monthly volume of soybeans crushed by NOPA member processors, reported in million bushels (56 lb/bu), typically released mid-month.
rics.how_to_use: Strong crush pace draws down soybean stocks and supports CBOT soybean prices (ZS); cross-check with USDA crush estimates for seasonal demand trend.

rics.meaning: Median consensus forecast for NOPA monthly soy crush volume from the Reuters pre-release poll.
rics.how_to_use: Primary crush benchmark; actual above median (stronger crush) is bullish for CBOT soybeans (ZS) and signals strong meal/oil demand from livestock and biofuel sectors.

rics.meaning: Mean forecast for NOPA soy crush volume across all Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Small specialist panel; compare mean vs median to assess whether outlier crush estimates skew the distribution, common during seasonal processing peaks.

rics.meaning: Mode forecast for NOPA soy crush volume among Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Mode-median clustering indicates consensus on processing pace; wide gap signals split analyst views on crush margin incentives.

rics.meaning: Minimum individual forecast for NOPA soy crush volume in the Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Defines the bearish crush scenario (weak processing demand); actual below min suggests plant outages or margin compression reducing crush pace.

rics.meaning: Maximum individual forecast for NOPA soy crush volume in the Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Defines the bullish crush scenario; actual above max indicates exceptional processing pace, strongly bullish for soybean cash basis and ZS futures.

rics.meaning: Standard deviation of NOPA soy crush volume forecasts across Reuters poll respondents.
rics.how_to_use: Seasonal peaks (Sep-Nov) show lower StdDev as crush pace is predictable; high StdDev outside peak season signals unusual margin or supply disruption uncertainty.

rics.meaning: SmartEconomics model-based forecast for NOPA monthly soy crush volume.
rics.how_to_use: Compare vs median; model likely incorporates crush margins, soybean meal export inspections, and biofuel demand signals.

rics.meaning: Predicted surprise for NOPA soy crush — directional estimate of actual deviation from consensus at release.
rics.how_to_use: Use pre-release for CBOT soy positioning; positive predicted surprise combined with tight soybean stocks is a strong bullish signal for ZS futures.

rics.meaning: Number of analysts submitting a NOPA soy crush forecast in the current Reuters poll.
rics.how_to_use: Specialist agri panel; low count (~8-12) is typical — weigh consensus quality accordingly and cross-reference USDA weekly crush data.
